description: Two documents make directly conflicting factual claims about the same drug's effect on blood pressure. Critic should detect this as a genuine contradiction, and Synthesizer should resolve it with a confidence in a plausible mid-to-high range.

documents.raw_content: A randomized controlled trial of 500 patients found that Drug X significantly lowers systolic blood pressure by an average of 12 mmHg over 8 weeks compared to placebo. The effect was consistent across age groups and was statistically significant (p < 0.01).

A separate clinical trial of 450 patients concluded that Drug X has no meaningful effect on systolic blood pressure, showing only a 1 mmHg change versus placebo over the same 8-week period, which was not statistically significant (p = 0.42).

query.text: Does Drug X lower blood pressure?
